title: Gretta Conroy
html_source:
Of Dubliners fame brilliantly embodied by John Huston. This is a hint from Joyce that all’s not well in the Bloom’s – in her epiphanic recollection of the death of a teenage persuant she destroys Gabriel Conroy’s (her husband) soul. The reader may already be guessing Blazes is taking Molly.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aE4p78yQit0

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Some have argued that Gretta’s remembrance of love lost saved her husband’s soul.
